notes: Encoded ONLY from Magic-Pak's own page. No styles imported from sister brands (Magic Chef, Ducane, Lennox, etc.) even where shapes coincide — each style below is justified from this page's own text. All four styles ship: Styles 1 and 2 year-only (month letter chart-only), Style 3 year-only (month letter chart-only; day not encoded — the schema has no day field), Style 4 year + week. All four patterns are disjoint.

styles.notes: Year = 3rd-4th character numerical digits (normalized positions [2,4] -> '06'). Month = 5th character letter, chart-only, so year-only.
Year = 1st-2nd numerical digits (normalized positions [1,3] -> '89'). Month = 3rd character, chart-only, so year-only.

Year = 4th-5th numerical digits REVERSED: in the normalized serial 15A67JA098 the 4th numerical digit is '7' (position 4) and the 5th is '0' (position 7), so split positions [[7,8],[4,5]] concatenate to '07' -> 2007. Month = 3rd character letter, chart-only, so year-only. Day = 1st-2nd numerical digits (15) is stated on the page but not encoded (no day field in the schema).
Page positions 7-8 = year, 9-10 = week (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges.
